articles.headline: Big 12 first power conference to have full CSC participation
articles.description: The Big 12 is becoming the first Power Four conference to have each of its members sign participation agreements with the College Sports Commission.

articles.headline: College teams that won -- or lost -- at the NBA draft withdrawal deadline
articles.description: Vanderbilt stays in the national conversation with Tyler Tanner's return. Here are more high-impact decisions.

articles.headline: Arizona star Koa Peat to remain in NBA draft
articles.description: Arizona forward Koa Peat, a projected first-round pick, is keeping his name in the NBA draft.

images.name: Koa Peat gets inside and sends in an early dunk for Arizona.
images.caption: Koa Peat starts this sweet 16 match off with an impressive dunk.

articles.headline: Vanderbilt PG Tyler Tanner withdraws from NBA draft
articles.description: Vanderbilt's Tyler Tanner, one of the elite point guards in the country, told ESPN on Wednesday that he has withdrawn from the NBA draft and will return for his junior season.

articles.headline: Milan Momcilovic withdraws from NBA draft, set for college return
articles.description: Former Iowa State forward Milan Momcilovic, the No. 1 player in the transfer portal, is withdrawing from the NBA draft and will play college basketball next season, his agents told ESPN.

images.caption: Milan Momcilovic went on a 9-0 run for Iowa State to end the half.
